summary: ASTROCARE is an AI-powered health monitoring software designed to help astronauts independently monitor and manage their health during long-duration space missions. It collects and analyses multiple health indicators, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, physical activity, sleep patterns, stress levels, immune-related assessments, and radiation exposure. Using machine learning, the system identifies unusual health patterns, tracks changes from individual health baselines, and generates early warnings about potential health risks. It also provides personalized health insights and medically approved recommendations to help astronauts take appropriate action. With offline monitoring and secure local data storage, ASTROCARE continues functioning even when communication with Earth is delayed or unavailable. By combining physical, mental, and environmental health monitoring in one platform, ASTROCARE aims to improve astronaut self-health management, support early risk identification, and contribute to safer and healthier long-duration space exploration.
details:
ASTROCARE – Intelligent Astronaut Health Monitoring System

ASTROCARE is an AI-powered software that helps astronauts monitor and manage their physical and mental health during long-duration space missions. It collects health indicators such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, sleep patterns, stress, physical activity, and radiation exposure. Machine learning analyses the collected data, identifies unusual patterns, and generates early warnings with personalized health recommendations.

The system helps astronauts recognize potential health problems early, make informed health decisions, and monitor their well-being independently, even when communication with Earth is unavailable.

Technologies Used: Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Flask, Scikit-learn, and SQLite. Simulated sensor data will be used initially, with scope for wearable sensor integration.

Innovation: Unlike ordinary health monitoring applications, ASTROCARE combines physical, mental, and environmental health monitoring with AI-based risk detection and offline functionality.

Factors Considered: Space radiation, microgravity, isolation, data privacy, system reliability, individual health differences, and ease of use.

Intended Impact: To improve astronaut safety, support early health risk identification, and enable healthier and safer long-duration space exploration.
